parsed.rationale: The migration budget violation is caused by two migrations (analyze and ingest) from sat-b to sat-a. The node_score currently has a negative weight on dependency_latency, which may favor placing services on nodes with lower dependency latency, potentially leading to migrations. Setting the weight to 0 removes this incentive, possibly reducing migrations and thus the violation.

improvement before deterministic evaluation.
